why: Squares and circles take turns, so the 5th figure is a square. The square turns a quarter turn clockwise: the black part of figure 1 (left) moves to the top and the hatched part (top) moves to the right, with its lines turning from standing to lying. That is option 5. Option 4 has the hatching at the bottom with standing lines, so it is wrong.
trick: When a figure turns, the shading lines turn with it: vertical lines become horizontal after a quarter turn.
note: Option 5 is figure 1 turned 90 degrees clockwise; figure 3 does not follow the same simple step, so the rule is a best reading of the book answer.
